name: custody_default_bail_periods
description: Statutory default-bail (police-custody) periods from first remand. 'general' selects 60 or 90 days by offence gravity; each special statute overrides with its own period and extension mechanics.

source.act: CrPC s.167(2) / BNSS s.187; NDPS Act s.36A(4); UAPA s.43D(2); PMLA
source.section: Chaganti Satyanarayana v. State of AP (period runs from first remand)

uapa.extension_procedure: 90+90 on a reasoned report of the Public Prosecutor
